title: Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract Claims Manual: Paying a Covered Repair Visit and Its Benefits
content:
**Clause.** Labor is paid at the plan's percent of the facility's posted retail labor rate, diagnostics are paid where the plan covers diagnostic time, Kestrel genuine parts are required where the plan requires genuine parts only, and an independent facility may be used only where the plan allows an independent facility. One deductible applies per repair visit, waived at the selling dealer where the plan carries the selling-dealer waiver; at most the plan's number of repair lines per visit are covered. Rental is reimbursed at the plan's daily rental allowance for up to the plan's maximum rental days, towing up to the plan's towing amount per occurrence, trip interruption at the plan's daily trip interruption amount for up to the plan's maximum trip interruption days when the breakdown is more than the plan's minimum distance from home, and smart key replacement up to the plan's key replacement limit; whether roadside service is part of the plan is stated by the plan's roadside assistance setting.

Each figure and setting named in this clause is the one set for the Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract plan held, from Kestrel Care Powertrain to Kestrel Care Platinum Elite.

## Repair itself

| Item | How it is settled on a covered repair |
|---|---|
| Labor | At the plan's percent of the repair facility's own posted retail labor rate |
| Diagnostic time | Paid where the plan covers diagnostics and the failure is covered |
| Parts | Kestrel genuine parts where the plan requires them |
| Facility | An ASE-certified independent facility only where the plan allows one |
| Deductible | One per repair visit; none at the selling Kestrel dealer on a plan carrying the selling-dealer waiver |
| Repair lines | Covered up to the plan's number of lines per visit |

## Benefits beside the repair

| Benefit | Measure | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| Rental car | The plan's daily rental allowance | Up to the plan's maximum rental days for the covered repair visit |
| Towing | Up to the plan's towing amount | Per covered breakdown |
| Trip interruption (lodging and meals) | The plan's daily trip interruption amount | Up to the plan's maximum days, only when the breakdown is more than the plan's minimum distance from home |
| Smart key | Up to the plan's key replacement limit | For a lost or damaged smart key |
| Roadside assistance | Part of the plan where the plan includes it | — |

### Worked figures (hypothetical plan settings)

- *Rental.* With a hypothetical daily allowance of 30.00 and a maximum of 4 days, a covered repair visit during which a rental car is used for 6 days while the repair is performed is reimbursed for 4 days at 30.00, which is 120.00; one with 3 rental days is reimbursed for 3 days, which is 90.00.
- *Trip interruption.* With a hypothetical daily amount of 90.00, a maximum of 2 days and a minimum distance of 100 miles, a breakdown 140 miles from home with 3 nights away is reimbursed for 2 days at 90.00, which is 180.00. A breakdown exactly 100 miles from home is not more than 100 miles, and one 60 miles from home is well inside it; neither meets the distance condition.
- *Repair lines.* On a hypothetical plan covering 4 lines per visit, a visit presenting 6 covered lines has 4 of them covered.
- *Deductible.* A hypothetical plan written with a 100.00 deductible and carrying the selling-dealer waiver: a visit at the selling Kestrel dealer carries no deductible; a visit at another Kestrel dealer carries one deductible of 100.00, however many lines it has.
